title: Choose the VISTA 128 composition
question: Which composition should become the real Vista home page?

options.label: The whole computer
options.thesis: The opening viewport is one complete VISTA 128 machine with screen, keys, and manual below.
options.viewport: The computer fills the frame; screen commands and function keys perform navigation.
options.risk: The full keyboard can consume too much space on smaller laptops.

options.label: VISTA 128 desktop
options.thesis: A cobalt windowed operating system lets visitors explore Vista before they download it.
options.viewport: One large command window leads, with catalog and system-monitor windows behind it.
options.risk: Needs disciplined z-order and mobile adaptation to avoid novelty clutter.

options.label: The living manual
options.thesis: A programmer’s reference manual has a working cobalt terminal physically inset into its page.
options.viewport: The terminal proves the product while annotations and tabs turn the whole page into documentation.
options.risk: The denser manual language asks more attention from first-time visitors.
